# Shubhransh Gupta — AI & Systems Engineering Lab

> Systems & On-Device AI Engineer based in Bengaluru, India. Focusing on Apple Silicon Metal GPU acceleration (mlx-swift), Swift 6 concurrency, INT4/AWQ quantization, and autonomous multi-agent systems orchestration.

Full comprehensive dossier and deep technical specs: [https://shubhransh-gupta.is-a.dev/llms-full.txt](https://shubhransh-gupta.is-a.dev/llms-full.txt)

## Executive Summary

- **Identity**: Shubhransh Gupta (commonly also searched as Subhransh Gupta).
- **Core Engineering**: Systems engineering at the intersection of native mobile architecture and local-first AI intelligence. Senior iOS Engineer at Coupang.
- **AI Specialization**: On-device SLM/LLM inference optimization, Apple Silicon Metal GPU acceleration (`mlx-swift`), INT4/AWQ quantization, and autonomous multi-agent systems orchestration.
- **Mobile Scale**: 5+ years building consumer mobile architectures reaching 50M+ users across Coupang, Navi, MakeMyTrip, and Nuclei.

## Frontier AI & Systems Projects

- **toknt** (https://github.com/shubhransh-gupta/toknt): Local-first AST context and token optimizer for AI coding agents (Cursor, Claude Code, Codex). Strips boilerplate syntax and compresses prompt tokens by up to 60%.
- **ShubhranshProxy** (https://github.com/shubhransh-gupta/ShubhranshProxy): Native macOS HTTP(S) proxy engine in Swift 6 with on-the-fly SSL decryption, mock breakpoints, and HAR streaming.
- **MirrorLock** (https://github.com/shubhransh-gupta/mirrorLock): Native macOS security utility allowing live visual observation of autonomous background AI agents while locking input and unlocking with Touch ID.
- **scavengers-assemble** (https://github.com/shubhransh-gupta/scavengers-assemble): 3D isometric simulation engine orchestrating multi-agent LLM interactions in real-time.
- **Courier City** (https://github.com/shubhransh-gupta/courier-city): 60 FPS 3D WebGL procedural simulation engine with rigid-body vehicle physics.

## Key Upstream Contributions

- **Apple mlx-swift** (Merged PR #467): Corrected convolution padding bounds calculation in Metal GPU kernels.
- **Apple swift-argument-parser** (Merged PR #961): Resolved core flag-parsing edge case with attached values in Swift CLI.
- **Apple swift-protobuf** (Merged PR #2159): Implemented deterministic ordering in TextFormat serialization for reproducible testing.
- **Apple swift-openapi-runtime** (Merged PR #214): Added validating mutating setters to dynamic OpenAPI value containers.
- **Tuist** (Merged PR #15500, Active PRs #15568 & #15566): Handled empty warning headers & simctl JSON; resilient simulator boot lifecycle and whoami token discovery.
- **Point-Free swift-snapshot-testing** (Active PR #1136): Enabled Swift Testing snapshot attachment recording when executing tests from the command line (`swift test --attachments-path`).
- **Google osv-scanner** (Merged PR #3049): Fixed vulnerability report filter state preservation in HTML output.
- **Fastlane** (Merged PR #30169): Guarded application-identifier prefix preservation in iOS code signing.
